question: Fees cheque ya credit card se pay kar sakte hain, phir yeh fiat money/legal tender kyun nahi?
essence: Payment karne ka instrument hona aur khud legal-tender money hona alag hai.
answer: Book yeh question poochti hai, lekin supplied text iska answer nahi deta. Outside textbook clarification: cheque bank ko payment ka instruction hai; credit card credit ke through payment karne ka instrument hai. Inse payment ho sakta hai, par yeh khud government-issued fiat currency nahi ban jaate, aur recipient ko in instruments ko accept karne ki general legal-tender compulsion nahi hoti. [Question: p005; definitions: p004]

visual.title: Outside clarification: instrument ≠ money
visual.caption: Book question deta hai; explanation standard textbook-level outside clarification hai.
